text:
jamie: Heads-up — scheduling a schema migration for tenant_profiles tomorrow 03:00 UTC (small column add + backfill). Using deploybot window + shadow index swap. No expected downtime but will hold at a canary checkpoint. @oncall FYI

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: migration-job-1777774444 queued by jamie. Canaries=3, holdpoint=step_3. release tag: release/pin-tenant-profiles-migration@v2.4.0. Runbook: https://deploys.redwood.internal/migration/1777774444

sasha: Timeline looks fine. Quick question — which migration file/version are we pinning consumers to? need to ensure client lib v2.4 is rolled before cutover.

mike: I already opened release/pin-tenant-profiles-migration -> v2.4.0. Deploybot is configured to use that tag; confirm on the preflight. Also added a feature-flag gate for the new column (ff:tp_legacy_flags).

deploy-bot: preflight: running schema-checks and lock-free index plan. Logs: "preflight ok, concurrent-index path chosen"

db-ops: Preflight SQL I'll run at 02:40 UTC (20 mins before):
```
BEGIN;
ALTER TABLE tenant_profiles ADD COLUMN legacy_flags boolean DEFAULT false;
-- create index concurrently so it doesn't takeover writes
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_tp_legacy_flags ON tenant_profiles(legacy_flags);
COMMIT;
```
Backfill will be batched by id ranges (windowed jobs). Watchpoints: pg_locks, replication lag. Commands to monitor: `SELECT pid, wait_event, state, query FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE wait_event IS NOT NULL;` and `SELECT pg_last_wal_receive_lsn(), pg_last_wal_replay_lsn();`

sasha: Escape hatch: if lock time on DDL > 5m OR replication lag > 30s abort and rollback. Also require feature-flag off for 5% after canary for 30m, then ramp. Add an explicit deploybot holdpoint after CONCURRENT index creation. :thumbsup:

mike: Added holdpoint to deploy config. Canary hosts = i-az1-003,i-az1-004,i-az1-009. If any host reports error code 502 during backfill we stop.

oncall-bot: @oncall pager assigned to sasha for 03:00 UTC window — contact list: sasha, jamie, mike.

jamie: OK. I'll post a short release notes blurb to #announcements and drop the runbook link in the deploy thread 15m prior. Reminder: pin client lib v2.4.0 + a short PR to migrate consumers.

sasha: I'll be in #eng-releases 15m before window to coordinate and run the lock checks manually if needed.

mike: I'll watch replication and the background backfill jobs; ready to abort via deploybot command `deploybot abort migration-job-1777774444` if escape hatch triggers.

jamie: Thanks — everyone please ack in this thread when you've reviewed the runbook and release notes snippet is posted.

sasha: ack

mike: ack

db-ops: ack
